cell.label: Patient with neurologic symptoms. Hyperacute onset (seconds to minutes).
Workup for other causes. Initially stroke, seizure, or migraine. If negative, consider neoplastic, infectious; see Differential Diagnosis section.
Localization to brain (unilateral weakness, vision, brainstem signs) or spinal cord (bilateral extremity weakness, sensory level, bowel/bladder)?
Order other scan (brain or spinal cord). Apply McDonald criteria (Table 1).
Lumbar puncture for oligoclonal bands, IgG index, IgG synthesis rate, and cell counts.
cell.path: Positive oligoclonal bands, IgG index, or IgG synthesis rate
Normal; repeat brain MRI in 3 months

cell.label: Interval new lesions meeting McDonald criteria?
Repeat brain MRI in 6 months and reassess for interval new lesions.
